items.difficulty_reason: 16 行陈述、相对 Mayer-Vietoris 三角形：绝对版引理（0GKK）施加于 K 后沿 Rf_! 推前 + shriek-composition 合成等式（0F7J）改写三项 + Rj_{U!} = j_{U!}（0GKM）。与 L22445 完全同型，三输入全具名即完整路线，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-relative-mayer-vietoris (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3862-3877

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: apply the absolute Mayer-Vietoris triangle for the cover X = U union V to K, push it forward by Rf_!, and identify the outer terms: Rf_! composed with Rj_{U!} (and its V analogue) is Ra_! (and Rb_!, Rc_!) by shriek-composition, while Rj_{U!} = j_{U!} by the quasi-finite computation (source lines 3879-3884)
